name: clanker
description: AI agent designed to automatically deploy tokens, specifically focusing on creating meme tokens on the Base

methodology.Fees: Total swap fees paid by traders in Clanker-deployed Uniswap v4 pools (creator fee + Clanker's 20% of creator fee).
methodology.Revenue: Clanker protocol's cut: 20% of the creator LP fee charged on top of each swap.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Clanker protocol's cut of swap fees, minus the amount spent buying back CLANKER (negative when a buyback exceeds the period's revenue).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: CLANKER tokens bought back and distributed to holders.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Token creator's LP rewards, claimable from the initial single-sided Uniswap v4 position.

Fees.Swap Fees: Total trading fees accrued in Clanker-deployed Uniswap v4 pools.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Clanker protocol's 20% cut of LP fees, tracked via WETH received by Clanker fee wallets.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: Clanker protocol's 20% cut of LP fees, tracked via WETH received by Clanker fee wallets.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: CLANKER tokens bought back and sent to the buyback wallet.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To Creators: Token creator's LP rewards, claimable from the initial single-sided Uniswap v4 position.
